verified.name: 1X Technologies
verified.description: Norwegian-American robotics and artificial intelligence company developing general-purpose humanoid robots for home and industrial environments, including the EVE wheeled humanoid robot and the NEO bipedal humanoid robot.
verified.notes: Company was originally founded as Halodi Robotics in 2014 and rebranded as 1X Technologies in 2022. Series A2 funding of $23.5M in March 2023 led by OpenAI Startup Fund. Series B funding of $100M in January 2024 led by EQT Ventures. Total raised calculation: $23.5M + $100M = $123.5M. Source [0] and [1] refer to a different company (wire and cable distributor also named 1X Technologies LLC based in Wyoming) and are not relevant to this robotics company.
